04 · CALCULUS AND TWO PARAMETERS

The gradient tells each parameter which way to move

General rule: θ(t+1) = θ(t) − η∇L(θ(t)). Partial derivatives are the ingredients of the gradient vector. Real losses can be non-convex, so a lower loss is not guaranteed at every step.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: B. Partial Derivatives All Parametersకి Gradient Vector Build చేస్తాయి. θ_new = θ_old − η∇L(θ_old). Learning Rate η Step Size. Example L(w,b)=(w−2)²+(b+1)² వద్ద (0,0), Gradient (−4,+2); η=0.25తో (1,−0.5).

05 · PYTHON FROM SCRATCH

Write the update loop yourself — no optimizer library

gradient_descent.py · plain Python
w = 0.0
rate = 0.2
history = []

for step in range(15):
    loss = (w - 3)**2
    history.append(loss)
    grad = 2 * (w - 3)
    w = w - rate * grad

print(round(w, 3))  # 2.999
Actual convergence of this code
Start w = 0End w ≈ 2.999Loss ≈ 5.5e-6

Derivative is hand-written because the toy loss is simple. For neural networks, backpropagation computes the many parameter gradients. You can run this code in any ordinary Python interpreter.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: A. Toy Pythonలో loss=(w−3)**2, grad=2*(w−3), w-=lr*grad Repeat చేస్తాం. Each Iteration Loss Record చేసి Graph Plot చేయవచ్చు. Deep Networksలో Backpropagation/Autograd Gradients Compute చేస్తాయి.

questions.figure:
06 · TWO DIFFERENT OPTIMIZER DECISIONS

Data used per update is separate from the update rule

Batch gradient descent · all examples

One update from the whole dataset. Accurate average; costly for large data.

Stochastic gradient descent · one example

One noisy update per example; can bounce around the loss landscape.

Mini-batch gradient descent · a small group

Uses a group each step; good balance of throughput and gradient noise.

Different optimizer rules on the gradientRMSProp: squared gradients Adam: first + second moments

Momentum, RMSProp and Adam can be used with mini-batches; they are not alternative batch-size definitions. In practice “SGD” often means mini-batch SGD.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: C. Batch Full Data Gradient, Strict SGD Single Example, Mini-Batch Group Gradient Use చేస్తాయి. Momentum Moving Direction, RMSProp Squared Gradients, Adam First+Second Moments Track చేస్తాయి. Hyperparameters Matter.

07 · LARGE-SCALE TRAINING CONTROL ROOM

Keep gradients useful, steps controlled, and workers synchronized

Backprop: derivativesSchedule + clippingSaddle: watch lossWorkers: sync updates

Vanishing gradients can slow learning, exploding gradients can destabilize it, and saddle points can stall progress. Clipping does not fix all three. Data-parallel workers typically aggregate gradients before each synchronized update.
